results.title: Ghana needs a dedicated hospitality school to improve standards – Ridge Royal Hotel MD
results.content: The Managing Director of Ridge Royal Hotel in Cape Coast, Sheila Adjetey-Anum, has called for the establishment of a dedicated hotel school in the country to equip hospitality workers with practical skills and improve service delivery.

results.title: Obuasi SHTS headmaster says rape accuser is 20 to 21, has a child
results.content: Suspended Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS) Headmaster, Zakaria Abdulai, has revealed that the girl who accused him of rape is between 20 and 21 years old and has a child.

results.title: Gender Ministry rolls out free breast and medical screening for Civil Service Staff
results.content: The Ministry of Gender, Children and Social Protection (MoGCSP) has commenced a free breast and medical screening exercise for Civil Service staff as part of activities marking Breast Cancer Awareness Month 2026.

results.title: Damang Gold Mine can operate for 15 more years with the right investment – Engineer
results.content: Mechanical engineer and certified inspecting engineer Obed Asamoah has expressed confidence in the future of Damang Gold Mine, saying the mine could remain operational for at least 15 more years if it receives the necessary investment.

results.title: Cape Coast has more to offer tourists beyond its castles – Ridge Royal MD
results.content: The Managing Director of Ridge Royal Hotel in Cape Coast, Sheila Adjetey-Anum, says the Central Region has more tourism opportunities to offer visitors beyond its historic castles and forts.

results.title: Atwima Mponua records 139 new HIV infections, second highest in Ashanti Region
results.content: The Atwima Mponua District has recorded 139 new HIV infections, making it the second highest in the Ashanti Region after the Kumasi Metropolitan Assembly.

results.title: Sex therapist calls for national sexuality education policy in Ghana
results.content: A US-trained sex therapist, Joshua Kwame Yeboah, has called on the government and stakeholders to develop a national sexuality education policy to address gaps in public understanding and strengthen professional practice in Ghana. Mr Yeboah, Founder and Chief Executive Officer of the Institute of Sexuality, Marriage and Family Life Research and Training (iSMART), said sexuality remained difficult to discuss constructively in many homes, schools, churches and communities. “In some homes, schools, churches and communities, sexuality remains too uncomfortable to discuss constructively. Young people may be warned against sexual activity without being adequately equipped to understand puberty, personal boundaries, consent, abuse prevention and responsible decision-making,” he said.

results.title: Protect vulnerable girls, not GES reputation – Dr Kwabena Tandoh
results.content: Former Deputy Director-General of the Ghana Education Service (GES), Dr Kwabena B. Tandoh, has urged educational leaders to prioritise protecting vulnerable girls in schools rather than focus on safeguarding the reputation of the service and other educational institutions. Speaking on The Pulse with Faustina Sarfo, he said allegations of abuse exposed through documentaries should prompt a broader examination of the systems responsible for protecting children in schools. “I think I first need to state clearly that our responsibility as educational leaders is not to protect the GES or educational institutions, but to protect the vulnerable girls who sit in our classrooms,” he said.

results.title: CSA and NITA order government institutions to fix critical PHP vulnerabilities within seven days
results.content: The Cyber Security Authority (CSA) and the National Information Technology Agency (NITA) have directed government institutions to address two critical vulnerabilities in PHP within seven days, warning that the flaws could allow attackers to take control of affected servers without a username or password.

results.title: Speculations about Asiedu Nketia’s presidential bid deepen as he skips NDC chairmanship contest
results.content: The National Democratic Congress (NDC) has confirmed that its National Chairman, Johnson Asiedu Nketiah, did not pick nomination forms to contest the party’s upcoming national executive elections. The party’s Director of Elections and IT, Mahdi Gibril, said Asiedu Nketiah, popularly known as “General Mosquito”, had not picked forms by the close of nominations and had not indicated an intention to contest. “These are those I know that did not pick. In any case, they did not indicate to us that they will pick,” Mr Gibril said. Although Asiedu Nketiah has not formally declared a presidential bid, his decision not to seek another term as national chairman comes amid speculation about whether he intends to contest the NDC’s presidential primary ahead of the 2028 general elections.

results.title: NAIMOS to launch Operation Greenshield at Atiwa Forest Reserve to combat illegal mining
results.content: The National Anti-Illegal Mining Operations Secretariat (NAIMOS) is planning a new forest protection operation, dubbed Operation Greenshield, beginning with the Atiwa Forest Reserve, as part of efforts to curb illegal mining.

results.title: GoldBod cites US$130m FX sale as cedi records weeks of appreciation
results.content: The Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod) has cited a US$130 million spot foreign exchange sale at GH¢11.60 per dollar as part of efforts to support the cedi and strengthen stability on the foreign exchange market.

results.title: NDC will not shield Obuasi SHTS headmaster over sexual abuse allegations – Fifi Kwetey
results.content: The National Democratic Congress (NDC) says it will not shield the suspended headmaster of Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS), Zakaria Abdulai, over allegations of sexual abuse, insisting that law enforcement agencies must conduct an independent and thorough investigation. Speaking at a press conference at the party’s headquarters on Thursday, October 22, 2026, General Secretary Fifi Kwetey said the party would not interfere in the investigation and wanted the truth to be established. “We do not endorse any such conduct and we want the law enforcement to do an independent job. We are sure they will, and this party would not in any way interfere,” he said.

results.title: NYA organises breast cancer screening for staff and community members
results.content: The National Youth Authority (NYA), led by its Chief Executive Officer, Osman Ayariga, has organised a breast cancer screening exercise to promote early detection and raise awareness about the disease among its staff and members of the surrounding community.

results.title: Lapaz driver remanded over alleged sale of 70 suspected unregistered drug tablets
results.content: An Accra Circuit Court has remanded a 38-year-old driver into police custody for allegedly offering 70 tablets of suspected unregistered Royal Tapentadol 250 mg for sale.

results.title: We’re mining actively; it’s untrue that we’re only treating existing stockpiles – Damang Gold Manager in charge of mining
results.content: Damang Gold Mine Ltd’s Manager of Mining, Frank Dankyi Agyei, has dismissed claims that the mine is relying solely on existing stockpiles for its operations, insisting that active mining is ongoing at multiple pits.

results.title: The Inconvenient Truth: Congratulations on your public sector board appointment. You are now automatically a politically exposed person (PEP)
results.content: The phone rings late one evening, and a courteous voice from the seat of government informs you that the President, wishes you to chair the board of a strategic state enterprise. By the following morning, your WhatsApp has received 237 messages, of which 230 offer heartfelt congratulations, six request employment for nephews of uncertain qualification, and one, from your bank, warmly invites you to submit updated evidence of your source of wealth. Only that last correspondent, it later emerges, fully understood what had happened. You had not merely accepted an honour; you had acquired a status, and in the language of global finance, you had become a Politically Exposed Person. Hence the spirit of this reflection: warm congratulations, and a quiet word of condolence.

results.title: I have been cautioned and granted self-recognisance bail – Obuasi SHTS Headmaster
results.content: The suspended Headmaster of Obuasi Senior High Technical School, Zakaria Abdulai, has stated that he has been cautioned and granted self-recognizance bail.

results.content: According to the economic research firm of the University of Ghana, though smaller deficits and lower debt reduce pressure on government financing and create conditions for greater macroeconomic stability, fiscal adjustment achieved through sharp reductions in capital spending may constrain infrastructure development and future growth.

results.content: Ghanaian actor, comedian and media personality Seth Kwame Dzokoto has died.

results.title: Financial performance as collateral: First National Bank expands access to unsecured business finance
results.content: Access to finance remains one of the biggest challenges facing small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), often due to limited collateral and inadequate financial records. In response, First National Bank is making it easier for qualifying businesses to obtain funding through pre-approved unsecured loans and overdraft facilities.

results.content: In its State of Ghana Economic Report (SGER), ISSER said Ghana’s macroeconomic recovery gained momentum in 2025, but growth remained uneven across sector.

results.content: Deputy Attorney-General Dr Justice Srem-Sai has warned that allowing the Court of Appeal’s decision to suspend the trial of Hanan Aludiba and his wife, Faiza Seidu, to stand could make it easier for criminal proceedings to be halted over objections to charges.

results.title: Uganda Revenue Authority delegation visits Tema Oil Refinery to study refining operations
results.content: A delegation from the Uganda Revenue Authority (URA) has visited the Tema Oil Refinery (TOR) to learn about Ghana’s experience in crude oil refining as Uganda advances plans to establish its own refinery.

results.title: GES mourns four pupils killed in Aboabo Junction accident
results.content: The Ghana Education Service (GES) has expressed condolences to the families of four pupils of Mahad Islamic School at Akotosu who died in a road accident at Aboabo Extension Junction in the Ashanti Region.

results.title: NAIMOS conducts 738 operations against illegal mining in four months
results.content: The National Anti-Illegal Mining Operations Secretariat (NAIMOS) says it conducted 738 operational activities between June 13 and September 30, 2026, as part of efforts to combat illegal mining and protect Ghana’s natural resources. Director of Operations at NAIMOS, Colonel K.S. Appiah, disclosed this during a media engagement, where he outlined the Secretariat’s operational achievements and plans to strengthen enforcement against illegal mining, popularly known as galamsey. According to him, the operations covered approximately 50,662 kilometres and included reconnaissance, mobile and riverine patrols, special operations and community engagement.

results.title: NAIMOS targets galamsey equipment suppliers, facilitators in renewed crackdown
results.content: The National Anti-Illegal Mining Operations Secretariat (NAIMOS) says it will intensify efforts to target the equipment suppliers and facilitators who support illegal mining, as it seeks to sustain cleared areas and strengthen the prosecution of offenders.

results.title: NAIMOS vows to sustain crackdown on illegal mining in rivers, forests and farms
results.content: The National Anti-Illegal Mining Operations Secretariat (NAIMOS) has reaffirmed its determination to halt illegal mining in Ghana’s rivers, forests, farms and plantations, declaring that operations against illegal miners and the networks supporting them will continue.

results.content: The National Democratic Congress (NDC) has closed nominations for its 2026 national executive elections, with 137 prospective aspirants picking forms to contest 14 positions ahead of the party’s 11th National Delegates Congress.

results.content: The two teams face each other on matchday eight of the league, with both teams hoping to continue their winning run from last weekend.

results.title: State appeals Court of Appeal ruling suspending Hanan’s trial over charge sheet dispute
results.content: The State has appealed to the Supreme Court against the Court of Appeal’s decision to suspend the criminal trial of former Buffer Stock CEO Hanan Aludiba and his wife, Faiza Seidu. Deputy Attorney-General and Minister for Justice, Dr Justice Srem-Sai, announced the appeal in a Facebook post on Thursday, October 22, 2026, saying it was filed on Wednesday, October 21. The appeal follows the Court of Appeal’s decision on Monday, October 19, to halt proceedings at the High Court pending the determination of Hanan Aludiba’s challenge to alleged defects in the charge sheet. Hanan Aludiba and his wife are standing trial on multiple charges, including stealing, defrauding by false pretences, wilfully causing financial loss to the Republic, using public office for profit, dishonestly receiving and money laundering.

results.title: Kweku Flick teams up with Shatta Wale on new single ‘Sweet’
results.content: Ghanaian musician Kweku Flick has teamed up with Shatta Wale on a new single titled Sweet, which explores resilience, confidence and the pursuit of success.

results.title: Ghana Water rewards prompt-paying customers as complaints over unreliable supply persist
results.content: Ghana Water Limited’s Accra East Region is rewarding customers who consistently pay their water bills on time, even as some beneficiaries raise concerns about unreliable supply. The initiative, organised as part of Customer Service Month, involves visits to selected domestic, commercial and industrial customers who are being presented with customised gifts in recognition of their prompt payments. Chief Manager of the Accra East Region, Richard Appiah Otto, said the programme was intended to encourage payment discipline and help the company mobilise revenue to address operational challenges. “We have extreme difficulties in getting some customers to pay their water bills,” he said.

results.title: Repatriation plans underway for 7 ‘missing but found’ Sekondi fishermen from Benin
results.content: Efforts are underway to repatriate seven fishermen aboard the canoe Second Chance who were reported missing at sea but have since been rescued in Benin’s territorial waters.
